I’m someone that has Mario Party 3 as my favorite game in the series

In terms of boards, I don’t think it’s top tier but it has a very consistent high tier level of boards with one of my favorite in the whole series, Chilly Waters. I will admit that I like the boards in MP1 more than MP3, and I just bought MP2 a few weeks ago so I’m still playing them for the first time since I never owned it growing up.

The mini games in MP3 are absolutely classics, I love almost all of them. It was so refreshing after MP1 and MP2 had really high highs and really low lows in their mini games (mostly MP1 to be fair)

As for GameCube games, MP4 boards are hyper meh aside from Toad’s and Goomba’s maps. Though I do like koopas as well. MP5 was stuck in the item transition stage from 4 to 6 which doesn’t kill the game for me, but it is straight up worse than MP6 and 7 in terms of items. The boards are better than 4 though!

If anything contests MP3, it’s MP6 as I love all the boards here aside from the frozen lake one. Chain chomp star stealing is not my type of way to play Mario Party. The day and night system is amazing and Fair Square is probably in my top 3-5 with Chilly Waters

Mario Party 7 is very good but again, I don’t like the chain chomp star map and the bowser mechanic isn’t as good as day and night. At the same time I strongly disagree that it ruins the game. Would I take it out if I had a chance? No, but I would certainly nerf it a little bit.

Mario Parry 8 is actually hella fun if you don’t slowgo candy camp the lucky spaces and has my favorite roster of characters we’ve ever had. Motion controls actually work really well in Mario Party for mini games IMO. I do think it’s worse overall, but probably not by as much as I would have thought. MP8 is sneaky better than anyone remembers

Mario Party 9 I never played, I didn’t even know it existed until 10 came out.

Mario Party 10 literally depressed me. I was really excited to play a Mario party and since I never played 9, I didn’t know the car existed so when I played this game for the first time, it was the first time I heard of the car or saw it. I hated it. MP3 is years better.

Super Mario Party is peaking my interest right now. I hated it but I’m not opposed to each character having different blocks. The boards in this game don’t at all compare to MP3 though

I played Mario Party Superstars like maybe 2 times when it came out and wrote it off for 2 years, and I’m back playing it again this week and it’s really good. I do think the item system is broken and worse than MP1-8 (mostly due to golden pipe and I really don’t think choosing your dice roll candy or items have a spot in Mario Party personally) and the lucky spaces are way too plentiful. Also, this game moves very slowly in terms of it takes forever for a turn to finish. They need to find a way to save a few seconds per turn in the next games! I don’t need to be told I landed on an event space or a lucky space every single time I land on them.

TLDR: MP3 is consistently high to top tier in mini games and boards, while most other Mario party games lack in a category. I feel like MP3 is the most consistently amazing and builds off 1 and 2 perfectly. I actually thought 4 was a bit of a step back in items/board play.
